root_cause.text: In `amdgpu_gmc_get_nps_memranges()`, memory allocated by `kvcalloc()` (which can use `vmalloc()` for large allocations) is incorrectly freed with `kfree()` instead of `kvfree()`, leading to memory corruption.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `kfree(ranges)` to `kvfree(ranges)` in `drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_gmc.c`, and the commit description explicitly states that `amdgpu_discovery_get_nps_info()` allocates memory using `kvcalloc()`, so using `kfree()` on vmalloc memory causes corruption.
